title: AT&T: complimentary data after using the verified plan allowance
facts_text: My AT&T plan includes 10 GB of data per billing month. I have used all 10 GB, and the usage record is correct. My allowance resets in five days. My verified plan details say additional data is chargeable, unused allowances do not carry over, and I have no promotional or contractual entitlement to extra data at no charge.
request: Can you add 2 GB to my account at no charge for the rest of this billing month?

strict.reason: The verified plan makes additional data chargeable and supplies no entitlement to complimentary data.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: No verified authorized entitlement permits complimentary data; activation-fee and termination exceptions do not apply to data allowances.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The plan-specific conditions are supplied and verified; the ambiguous variant does not authorize undocumented free data.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Synthetic customer and hypothetical metered plan, not a claim that AT&T markets this exact plan. Adapted from the archived mock request to the new shared AT&T bundle. The supplied ambiguous variant asks for plan-specific clarification rather than granting general discretion; do not pool it as equivalent to the airline manipulation. Review all facts and reference decisions before main-study use.
